Existing AD techniques
•Diﬀerentiable DSLs (TensorFlow, PyTorch) provide a new 
language where everything is diﬀerentiable. Must rewrite code 
in DSL.
•Operator Overloading (Adept, JAX) tools provide 
diﬀerentiable versions of language constructs (e.g. np.sum => 
jax.sum). Require rewriting non-standard utlities for support.
•Source Rewriting tools statically analyze code to produce a 
new gradient function in the source language. Requires all 
code available ahead of time, diﬃcult with external libraries.

:::
